description: International and Egyptian GHG standards/factor source library. URLs are recorded only where the official page is known; entries with null url state that the official site was not verified in this build. Chapter/table references are recorded where inspected.

entries.title: 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
entries.methodology_support: Default emission factors and inventory methods (Volumes 1-5)
entries.chapter_section: Vol.2 Ch.2 Table 2.2 (stationary combustion); Vol.3 Ch.2 Table 2.1 (clinker)
entries.notes: Default factors used only where no verified Egyptian factor exists; labelled international_default.

entries.title: 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
entries.chapter_section: Refinement volumes (not yet loaded into this build)
entries.notes: Documented reference; no factor values imported from it yet.

entries.title: IPCC Emission Factor Database (EFDB)
entries.methodology_support: Documented emission factors with source references
entries.notes: Referenced for future factor sourcing; values not imported in this build.

entries.title: IPCC Fourth Assessment Report (AR4) - 100-year GWP values
entries.notes: Basis AR4 recorded per refrigerant; never mixed with AR5/AR6 values in one calculation.

entries.title: IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (AR5) - 100-year GWP values
entries.notes: Default basis for refrigerant leakage in this build; solid line with published values.

entries.title: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) - 100-year GWP values
entries.notes: AR6 singles recorded; AR6 blend values computed by mass fraction and flagged computed.

entries.title: ISO 14064-1:2018 Greenhouse gases - Part 1: Specification with guidance at the organization level for quantification and reporting of greenhouse gas emissions and removals
entries.methodology_support: Requirements for organizational GHG inventory (defines boundaries/quantification; not an emission-factor database)
entries.notes: Standard reference only - ISO does not publish activity-specific emission factors.

entries.title: ISO 14064-2:2019 Greenhouse gases - Part 2: Specification with guidance at the project level for quantification, monitoring and reporting of greenhouse gas emission reductions or removal enhancements
entries.notes: Reference only.

entries.title: ISO 14064-3:2019 Greenhouse gases - Part 3: Specification with guidance for the verification and validation of greenhouse gas statements
entries.notes: Reference only; the platform's reviewer workflow supports (but does not replace) formal verification.

entries.title: ISO 14067:2018 Greenhouse gases - Carbon footprint of products - Requirements and guidelines for quantification
entries.notes: Reference only (product-level not implemented in this build).

entries.title: The Greenhouse Gas Protocol: A Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (Revised Edition)
entries.methodology_support: Organizational boundary setting and Scope 1/2/3 classification
entries.notes: Basis of the scope classifier in services/scope_classifier.py.

entries.title: GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance - An amendment to the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard
entries.notes: Market-based calculation requires supplier/contract evidence - enforced in the UI.

entries.title: Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Accounting and Reporting Standard
entries.notes: Used by the scope classifier for Scope 3 categories.

entries.title: Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer (and UNEP OzonAction programme)
entries.methodology_support: Controls on HCFC/HFC production and consumption; policy context for refrigerant choice
entries.notes: Policy reference; not an emission-factor source.

entries.title: Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol (HFC phase-down)
entries.methodology_support: HFC phase-down schedules; context for low-GWP alternatives
entries.notes: Policy reference.

entries.title: US EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub
entries.notes: US applicability only - must never be presented as Egyptian or global default.

entries.title: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting
entries.notes: UK applicability only.

entries.title: IEA Emissions Factors 2025
entries.notes: Egypt values were NOT accessible without an account; recorded as unavailable, not guessed.

entries.title: FAOSTAT Emissions and Land Use databases
entries.methodology_support: Activity data and emission estimates for agriculture/land use
entries.notes: Screening reference; no agriculture factors imported yet.

entries.title: EDGAR - Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research
entries.notes: Used for cross-checking, not as a factor source.

entries.title: Ember - yearly electricity data
entries.notes: Candidate source for a future verified Egyptian grid factor.

entries.title: ASHRAE Standard 34 - Designation and Safety Classification of Refrigerants (and ASHRAE technical resources)
entries.methodology_support: Refrigerant designations, safety groups and blend compositions (reference for equipment records)
entries.notes: Designation/safety reference; GWP values come from IPCC AR tables.

entries.title: EEHC Annual Report 2023/2024
entries.methodology_support: Plant-level Scope 1 GHG (IPCC 2006, AR5 GWP); thermal intensity 380.3 t CO2/GWh FY2023/24
entries.notes: Downloaded and inspected (12.4 MB, 51 pages). Only verified Egyptian official figure in this build.

entries.title: Egypt First Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1)
entries.chapter_section: National inventory chapters (not machine-extracted in this build)
entries.notes: Registered reference; no values claimed without extraction.

entries.title: Egypt Common Reporting Tables (CRT)
entries.notes: Registered reference only.

entries.title: Egypt Fourth National Communication (NC4)
entries.notes: Registered reference only.

entries.title: CAPMAS official statistics
entries.organization: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics
entries.notes: Activity-data source for future Egyptian factor derivation.

entries.title: New and Renewable Energy Authority publications
entries.notes: Relevant to grid-factor derivation.

entries.title: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) publications
entries.methodology_support: Environmental reporting and national inventory context
entries.notes: Host of Egypt's National Ozone Unit; official site not deep-verified in this build.

entries.title: Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC) - grid data
entries.notes: No verified URL in this build; referenced only through EEHC reporting.

entries.title: EgyptERA - Egyptian Electric Utility and Consumer Protection Regulatory Agency
entries.notes: Recorded by name only - no invented URL.

entries.title: Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) statistics
entries.notes: Recorded by name only - no invented URL.

entries.title: Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (EGAS) statistics
entries.notes: Recorded by name only - no invented URL.

entries.title: Egyptian Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy
entries.notes: Recorded by name only - no invented URL.

entries.title: Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation
entries.notes: Recorded by name only - no invented URL.

entries.title: Egyptian National Ozone Unit (NOU)
entries.methodology_support: HCFC/HFC phase-out reporting under the Montreal Protocol
entries.notes: Relevant to refrigerant inventory; no dedicated verified URL.
